jobs.description:

jobs.description:
Who will you be working with?
Wabtec is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value-added services. Whether it's freight rail, transit, mining, industrial, or marine, our expertise, technologies, and people - together - are accelerating the future of transportation.

Role: Senior Finance Manager
Location: Johannesburg

How will you make a difference?
As a Senior Finance Manager, you will oversee the entire finance function for a manufacturing operation within the rail sector. This includes budgeting, financial forecasting, operational finance, reporting, controllership, and statutory compliance. You will act as a key business partner to the Site Director and leadership team, driving execution, cost management, and working capital optimisation. A strong focus on process improvement and simplification will be essential.

What will your typical day look like?
- Financial leadership & planning: Lead annual budgeting, rolling forecasts, and pacing (orders, sales, costs, margins, cash), partnering closely with commercial, operational, and divisional stakeholders.
- Commercial & operational partnership: Support sales and tendering activities by evaluating deal economics and assumptions, while partnering with site leadership to drive operational execution and on‑time customer delivery across the end‑to‑end value chain.
- Risk, performance & insight: Provide financial insight, thought leadership, and visibility of risks and opportunities, ensuring actions and mitigations are clearly defined, tracked, and delivered.
- Reporting, governance & team leadership: Own monthly and quarterly close and reporting, supervise site finance operations, manage working capital and cash governance, and ensure compliance with corporate reporting and control requirements.
- Strategic enablement & stakeholder engagement: Drive simplification and efficiency initiatives, partner with regional and global support functions, and prepare Board materials while presenting business performance, risks, and opportunities.

What do we want to know about you?
- Education & experience: Bachelor’s degree in accounting or finance, with experience across FP&A, operational/manufacturing finance, and controllership or statutory compliance.
- Industrial & project finance expertise: Strong experience supporting industrial projects and programmes, including long‑term contract accounting, financial management, and reporting.
- Analytical & technical capability: Excellent analytical and problem‑solving skills, with a solid understanding of GAAP and data‑driven decision‑making.
- Communication & presentation: Fluent in English with strong written and verbal communication skills, including advanced PowerPoint and stakeholder‑level presentation experience.

If you don’t have all the above criteria don’t worry, we would still like to hear from you as we live our values and always put people first, and strive to expand what is possible.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Treasury Business Integration
jobs.description:
Position Summary
The Senior Manager, Treasury Business Integration leads Treasury activities supporting mergers and acquisitions, business integrations, cash repatriation planning, and strategic initiatives. This role partners with Corporate Development, Finance, Tax, Legal, and business leadership to assess Treasury risks, integrate acquired businesses into the company's Treasury framework, and improve access to cash across global operations.
Key ResponsibilitiesMergers and Acquisitions Due Diligence and Integration
- Lead Treasury due diligence for potential acquisitions, assessing cash availability, debt and financing arrangements, banking relationships, guarantees, foreign exchange exposures, and cash movement restrictions.
- Identify Treasury risks, transaction requirements, and integration costs; communicate findings and recommendations to transaction stakeholders.
- Develop and execute Treasury integration plans covering Day 1 readiness and post-close priorities, including banking, liquidity management, Treasury systems, policies, and controls.
- Coordinate with cross-functional teams to resolve integration issues and track progress against established milestones.

Business Treasury Integration
- Serve as the Treasury lead, in close coordination with the Regional Cash Manager, for integrating acquired and existing businesses into centralized Wabtec processes and governance, including Treasury operations, accounts payable processes, banking structures, and related financial activities.
- Evaluate Treasury practices across businesses and implement improvements in cash visibility, cash forecasting, banking structures, funding strategies, and payment controls.
- Coordinate the onboarding of businesses into cash pooling, intercompany financing, and Treasury reporting structures.
- Partner with business finance teams to establish clear ownership, accountability, and sustainable operating processes.

Cash Repatriation Planning
- Develop and coordinate cash repatriation strategies to support corporate liquidity and capital allocation objectives.
- Assess cash balances, local funding requirements, and regulatory or operational restrictions affecting the availability and movement of funds.
- Partner with Tax, Legal, Accounting, and local Finance teams to evaluate and execute appropriate cash repatriation methods, including dividends, intercompany settlements, and loan repayments.
- Monitor execution, resolve obstacles, and provide regular updates on timing, risks, and cash availability.

Special Projects
- In close coordination with the Regional Cash Managers, lead Treasury initiatives supporting business restructurings, legal entity rationalizations, operational improvements, and other strategic priorities.
- Develop project plans, coordinate stakeholders, manage dependencies, and deliver results within established timelines.
- Prepare analyses, recommendations, business cases, and progress updates for senior leadership.
- Ensure project outcomes align with Treasury policies, internal controls, and applicable regulatory and corporate requirements.

Qualifications & ExperienceRequired Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field.
- Minimum of 8 years of progressive experience in Treasury, Corporate Finance, Cash Management, Banking, or a related financial discipline.
- Demonstrated experience supporting mergers and acquisitions, including due diligence, integration planning, and post-acquisition execution.
- Strong knowledge of global cash management, liquidity planning, banking structures, intercompany funding, and Treasury controls.
- Experience managing cross-functional projects involving Finance, Tax, Legal, Accounting, and business stakeholders.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess complex financial and operational issues and develop practical solutions.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to influence stakeholders and present recommendations to senior leadership.
- Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and drive results in a fast-paced, global environment.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and financial analysis tools.

Preferred Qualifications
- Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
- Certified Treasury Professional (CTP), Certified Public Accountant (CPA), Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA), or equivalent professional designation.
- Experience with Treasury Management Systems (TMS), enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems, and banking platforms.
- Experience in a multinational manufacturing or industrial company.
- Knowledge of foreign exchange risk management, cash repatriation strategies, and international banking practices.

Leadership Competencies
- Demonstrated ability to lead complex projects and drive successful execution across multiple stakeholders.
- Builds effective partnerships across functions, regions, and organizational levels.
- Champions process improvement, change management, and operational excellence.
- Exercises sound judgment with a strong focus on risk management, governance, and internal controls.
- Delivers results through collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.

jobs.title: Program Manager – Retrofits
jobs.description:
Key missions of the position:
- The Retrofit Program Manager is responsible for developing, leading, and executing retrofit programs across the installed customer base.

- Works cross-functionally with Engineering, Product Management, Supply Chain, Sales, Field Service, Warranty, and Customers to ensure successful launch & completion of retro fitment.

- Coordinate with Regional Service & Warranty leaders to ensure timely completion of retrofit activities.

Roles & Responsibilities
1. Retro fitment Program Strategy & Development
- Develop, implement, and manage retrofit programs for the installed base across all product lines.

- Define program scope, deployment strategy, timelines, milestones, and resource requirements.

- Prepare business cases and white papers for management approval, including retrofit budgets and implementation plans.

- Responsible to maintain complete database of the existing Population of all our product lines.

2. Program Execution:
- Lead end-to-end execution of retrofit programs from concept through deployment.

- Review FMI Document and work with Safety team for HIRA assessment prior to implementation.

- Collaborate with Field Service teams to develop deployment plans and ensure successful retrofit execution at customer sites.

- Develop deployment methodologies, technical documentation, training materials, and service procedures.

- Work with Engg. /PED/Sourcing team for special tool development/procurement related to retro fitment programs

3. Retrofit Material Order Planning & Execution:
- Plan initial Float Stock requirements & Load Forecast order in the system for new retro fitment launch

- Periodically Review & update the forecast order in system based on the actual orders.

- Receive & Process retro fitment order request from FSE’s and ensure demand creation in ERP.

- Coordinate with SCM and Operations teams to ensure on-time material availability and order fulfilment.

- Responsible to have full control on customer return material (MCO orders).

4. Customer Engagement:
- Act as the primary contact for strategic customers regarding retrofit initiatives.

- Publish Weekly/Monthly Retrofit completion Dashboards to Internal Management & Customers (RDSO & Private Car builders)

- Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction throughout program execution.

5. Safety, Quality, and Compliance:
- Ensure all work is performed in accordance with our organization’s strict safety, quality, and compliance standards.

- Promote a strong safety culture and ensure all field deployment activities comply with applicable EHS requirements.

Key KPIs:
- Retrofit HIRA Compliance (%): HIRA completed before deployment (Target – 100%)

- Retrofit Completion Rate %:  Commitment - As per Program Plan & Target - >95%

- Dashboard Reporting Compliance:  Commitment – 95% & Target – 100%

Education/Training
- Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering

Professional Experience
- Minimum 8 to 10 years of experience.

Languages
- English & Hindi & Tamil

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Program Manager - Reliability Solutions
jobs.description:
Wabtec Corporation is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions and value-added services for freight and transit rail. Drawing on nearly four centuries of collective experience across Wabtec, GE Transportation and Faiveley Transport, the company has unmatched digital expertise, technological innovation, and world-class manufacturing and services, enabling the digital-rail-and-transit ecosystems. Wabtec is focused on performance that drives progress, creating transportation solutions that move and improve the world. The freight portfolio features a comprehensive line of locomotives, software applications and a broad selection of mission-critical controls systems, including Positive Train Control (PTC). The transit portfolio provides highly engineered systems and services to virtually every major rail transit system around the world, supplying an integrated series of components for buses and all train-related market segments that deliver safety, efficiency and passenger comfort. Along with its industry-leading portfolio of products and solutions for the rail and transit industries, Wabtec is a leader in mining, marine and industrial solutions. Wabtec has approximately 29,000 employees in facilities throughout the world.
- Visit the company’s new website at: http://www.WabtecCorp.com
- It is not just about your career… or your job title…it is about who you are and the impact you are going to make on the world. Do you want to go into uncharted waters…do things that have not been done to make yours and someone else's life better? Wabtec has been doing that for decades and we will continue to do so! Through our people, leadership development, services, technology and scale, Wabtec delivers better outcomes for global customers by speaking the language of industry.

Role Summary/Purpose
Senior Engineering Program Manager – Reliability Solutions is responsible for leading fleet reliability improvement programs across Wabtec locomotive platforms. This role owns end-to-end problem resolution from root cause identification through solution deployment and effectiveness validation. The position combines technical leadership, reliability engineering, metallurgy expertise, and program management to improve fleet availability, reduce lifecycle costs, and enhance customer satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities:
- Assess and perform root-cause investigations for field reliability issues. Be responsible for and perform hands-on locomotive-level field investigations of various issues to establish root-cause of reported issues.
- Develop containment/immediate-term solution for reported field issues. Implement short-term as well as long-term solutions for field failures. Deliver on field reliability goals & risks
- Lead metallurgical and materials-related investigations including fatigue failures, wear mechanisms, corrosion, fracture analysis, welding defects, casting/forging anomalies, and material degradation to establish root cause and corrective actions.
- Drive and track international material movement, project ROI, launch readiness, scope management, reporting, and service readiness activities.
- Create implementation plans and validate execution with GLO/GSO: supply chain capacity, material usage rates, eServices, customer acceptance
- Support and coordinate with interfacing organizations such as manufacturing, sourcing, services, global engineering, and systems engineering.
- Execute reliability solutions development through Wabtec services tollgate process and deliver the same to customer.
- Communicate progress to all levels of the organization, systematically track all reported field reliability issues through various stages through solution development, deployment, and effectiveness validation.

Qualifications/Requirements
- Bachelor’s or master’s degree from an accredited university or college with 15 to 20 years of engineering experience in either Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Metallurgical Engineering, Materials Engineering, or related engineering discipline.
- Hands-on experience in solving reliability issues, root-cause analysis, reliability modeling methods & analysis techniques.
- Training / Certification in reliability and Six Sigma – DMAIC, DFSS, DFR
- At least 2 to 3 years of experience in a systems, sub-system, program, or project leadership role within engineering CoEs.
- Willingness and ability to travel ~ 10% of the time.
- Proven expertise in engineering requirement flow down, design and development, engineering tollgate process, NPI and requisition development, familiarity with Wabtec reliability services tollgate process
- Strong understanding of materials engineering and metallurgy principles, including fatigue, fracture mechanics, wear, corrosion, heat treatment processes, welding, casting, forging, and material selection for heavy-duty industrial applications

Desired Characteristics:
- Advanced degree in Mechanical Engineering, Metallurgical Engineering, Materials Engineering, or related discipline with relevant locomotive, rail, heavy equipment, mining, aerospace, or industrial equipment experience is preferred.
- Demonstrated expertise in metallurgical failure analysis, material characterization, and reliability improvement of mechanical systems is highly desirable.
- Proven ability to drive/embrace change & drive innovation.
- Proven problem solving, analytical skills & new idea generation.
- Good interpersonal, communication and organizational integration skills
- Strong interpersonal and leadership skills
- Strong oral and written communication skills
- Familiarity with manufacturing processes

Relocation will be provided for deserving candidate.

jobs.title: Finance Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
In dieser Schlüsselposition übernehmen Sie die Leitung der Bereiche Accounting und FP&A am Standort Schüttorf. Sie stellen eine ordnungsgemäße Finanzberichterstattung sicher, steuern Budgetierungs- und Forecast-Prozesse und unterstützen das Management bei finanziellen und operativen Entscheidungen. Darüber hinaus treiben Sie die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung und Automatisierung der Finance-Prozesse voran und leisten einen wesentlichen Beitrag zu Transparenz, Profitabilität und nachhaltigem Unternehmenserfolg.

In dieser Position sind Sie unter anderem für folgende Aufgaben verantwortlich:

- Fachliche und disziplinarische Führung des Accounting-Teams sowie Leitung des FP&A-Teams am Standort in Schüttorf
- Verantwortung für Kreditoren-, Debitoren- und Hauptbuchhaltung sowie Bilanzabstimmungen
- Sicherstellung vollständiger, korrekter und termingerechter Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüsse
- Unterstützung bei der Erstellung und Prüfung von Jahresabschlüssen
- Koordination gesetzlicher Meldungen, unter anderem Umsatzsteuervoranmeldungen sowie zusammenfassende Meldungen
- Sicherstellung der Einhaltung interner Richtlinien, Prozesse, Kontrollen und gesetzlicher Anforderungen
- Steuerung der Budgetierungs-, Forecast- und Business-Planning-Prozesse
- Analyse der finanziellen und operativen Performance sowie Identifikation wesentlicher Einflussfaktoren und Risiken
- Unterstützung bei Wirtschaftlichkeitsberechnungen, Investitionsentscheidungen und der Optimierung des Working Capitals
- Beratung der Geschäftsführung und Standortleitung auf Basis fundierter Finanzanalysen
- Weiterentwicklung, Standardisierung und Automatisierung von Accounting-, Reporting- und Finance-Prozessen
- Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Corporate Finance, internen Fachbereichen, Wirtschaftsprüfung und Steuerberatung
Sie erfüllen idealerweise folgende fachlichen und persönlichen Anforderungen:

- Sie verfügen über ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Betriebswirtschaftslehre mit Schwerpunkt Accounting oder Finance, eine Qualifikation als Bilanzbuchhalter (m/w/d) oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
- Sie haben mindestens acht Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung mit fundiertem Accounting-Hintergrund sowie Erfahrung in FP&A, Controlling oder Financial Analysis
- Sie verfügen über mehrjährige Führungserfahrung und nachgewiesene Kompetenz in der Leitung von Teams und bereichsübergreifenden Finance-Themen
- Sie besitzen umfassende Kenntnisse in Monats- und Jahresabschlüssen, Bilanzabstimmungen, gesetzlicher Berichterstattung sowie in der Begleitung von Prüfungen
- Sie verfügen über ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten und ein gutes Verständnis für finanzielle und operative Zusammenhänge
- Sie zeichnen sich durch eine strukturierte, lösungsorientierte und eigenständige Arbeitsweise aus
- Sie verfügen über ein hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein sowie ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Priorisierungsfähigkeiten
- Sie haben Erfahrung in der Standardisierung und Automatisierung von Prozessen sowie in der Verbesserung der Datenqualität und sind sicher im Umgang mit KI-Anwendungen
- Sie sind sicher im Umgang mit MS Office, insbesondere Excel, sowie mit ERP- und Reporting-Systemen; Kenntnisse in ABAS und OneStream sind von Vorteil
- Sie verfügen über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
- Sie haben Erfahrung in einem internationalen Umfeld und einer Matrixorganisation, idealerweise in einem produzierenden Unternehmen
Was könnten Sie erreichen an einem Ort, an dem der Mensch im Mittelpunkt steht?
Bei Wabtec ist es mehr als nur ein Job - es geht darum, was Sie bewirken. Wenn wir als Team zusammenarbeiten, erweitern wir die Grenzen des Möglichen, indem wir ständig besser werden - in dem was wir tun und wie wir es tun - sowohl für unsere Kunden als auch füreinander.
Wenn Sie bereit sind die Mobilität für kommende Generationen zu revolutionieren, dann sind Sie bei Wabtec genau richtig.

Wabtec ist ein weltweit führender Anbieter von Ausrüstung, Systemen, digitalen Lösungen und Mehrwertdiensten für den Güter- und Nahverkehr. Mit über 150 Jahren Erfahrung setzen wir Maßstäbe in Sicherheit, Effizienz, Zuverlässigkeit, Innovation und Produktivität. Ob Güterverkehr, Nahverkehr, Häfen, Logistik, Bergbau, Industrie oder Schifffahrt – unser Fachwissen, unsere Technologien und unsere Mitarbeitenden gestalten gemeinsam die Zukunft des Transports. Mit rund 30.000 Teammitgliedern weltweit liefern wir Leistungen, die die Welt voranbringen. Wir hören nie auf zu lernen und sind ständig darauf aus, besser zu werden. Erfahren Sie mehr unter www.WabtecCorp.com.

jobs.title: Equipment Program Management Regional Leader
jobs.description:
We are looking for an Equipment Program Management Regional Leader to supervise locomotive, kits, and engine program managers. This position will work closely with product managers and systems engineers, leading cross-functional teams to execute multi-million dollar locomotive and engine contracts. The role requires coordination with domestic and global business leaders to deliver projects on time and on budget, meeting all contractual requirements and satisfying our customers.
How will you make a difference?
A primary focus of the role will be leading programs for locomotives built in Kazakhstan , and working closely with Wabtec production partners. You will collaborate with warehouse and supply chain leaders to achieve efficient and timely deliveries that support manufacturing build schedules and overall program success, as well as develop a world-class team of program managers.
What will your typical day look like?
- Lead team and mentor program managers on creating integrated program management plans, leading, managing, monitoring, and controlling all project work.
- Ensure successful closure of programs and effective handoff to the services teams; evaluate and prioritize lessons learned to drive action for improvement.
- Manage program scope changes and act as the business tollgate approver.
- Review and ensure compliance to detailed and harmonized program schedules; drive milestone schedule adherence for proposals.
- Forecast, manage, and control total program costs including NRE, ACO, and logistics.
- Drive revenue, cash, and margin attainment; help team develop program financial forecasts.
- Incorporate the quality policy regarding planning, managing, and controlling project and product quality requirements.
- Facilitate customer inspections, testing, and overall acceptance of locomotives and contract deliverables.
- Identify, acquire, and manage the resources needed for the successful completion of projects.
- Lead executive program reviews; ensure timely and appropriate program communications, including business letters to customers.
- Monitor and ensure mitigation of program risks; maintain program risk registers.
- Identify the people, groups, or organizations impacted by the project; analyze and manage stakeholder expectations.

What do we want to know about you?
- Higher professional education (Bachelor’s degree or higher)
- Minimum of 8 years of experience in Program Management
- Demonstrated locomotive/marine or other large industrial product line, systems, or manufacturing knowledge
- International program management experience working in a global organization, including direct collaboration with stakeholders, customers, suppliers, or cross-functional teams in the United States and/or India.
- Proven ability to lead complex multinational projects across different time zones, cultures, and business environments.
- Exceptional oral and written communication skills
- Exceptional interpersonal and leadership skills
- Strong financial acumen
- Strong competency in Microsoft applications including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Project
- Legal authorization in Kazakhstan is required
- Fluency in English is required

Desired Characteristics:
- BS/MS in electrical or mechanical engineering, supply chain, or operations
- Experience with Profit & Loss accountability
- Experience with Oracle SCM and ASCP or equivalent
- Commercial operations/contract management experience
- PMP certification

jobs.title: Finance Manager
jobs.description:
Who will you be working with?
Bloom Engineering, a Wabtec Company,  improves the environmental sustainability and performance of industrial heating applications, with a strong focus on the aluminum and steel industries. Headquartered in Pittsburgh, USA, since 1934, Bloom Engineering serves a global customer base through subsidiaries in Germany, India, and China.
Leveraging deep expertise in furnace and heating applications, Bloom Engineering helps customers reduce CO₂ and NOₓ emissions, transition to sustainable fuel sources, increase production capacity, improve temperature uniformity, reduce fuel consumption, and enhance operating flexibility—delivering meaningful competitive advantage.
How will you make a difference?
As Finance Manager to the Finance Controller, you will drive financial excellence through comprehensive treasury management, ensuring optimal cash operations, and maintaining rigorous compliance with SOX, US GAAP, and international reporting standards. The role demands a strategic professional who can provide critical insights into project accounting, revenue recognition, and financial risks while fostering a collaborative team environment focused on continuous improvement and operational efficiency. This position is essential for supporting executive decision-making, managing complex financial processes, and delivering high-impact financial leadership across the organization.
What do we want to know about you?
- Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, or related field; or five or more years related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
- Strong knowledge of financial reporting and analysis, including U.S. GAAP (IFRS knowledge a plus), and experience with ERP and accounting systems (e.g., Sage, SAP, Epicor, Power BI).
- Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including PivotTables, XLOOKUP, and complex formulas.
- Experience with month-end close and financial statement preparations
- Experience with inventory, cost accounting, and WIP accounting.
- Energetic, curious, resourceful, highly creative and self-motivated.  Able to thrive in a fast-moving and sometimes ambiguous environment
- Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to effectively engage and influence cross functionally
- Understanding of continuous improvement, lean manufacturing concepts, and production schedules
- Capable of planning and organizing work and processes; ability to self-direct multiple projects and meet deadlines.
- Motivation to provide excellent internal and external customer service
- Strong analytical, quantitative, and problem-solving skills with sound professional judgment.
- Experience working within a publicly traded company or SOX-controlled environment, preferred

What will your typical day look like?
- Financial reporting support for all areas of financial operations including:
- Prepare monthly journal entries and supporting schedules.
- Prepare and reconcile intercompany transactions within the Group companies as well as with Corporate Headquarters to ensure proper ledger reporting.
- Prepare G/L account reconciliations and resolve reconciling items within 30 days of month-end closing.
- Maintain the integrity of the general ledger and ensure compliance with accounting procedures and policies.
- Assist with fixed asset accounting, capitalization, depreciation, and asset tracking.
- Develop and maintain standard labor and overhead rates for inventory costing.
- Prepare weekly business metrics, risks and opportunities reporting, and other management reporting.
- Identify opportunities to improve accounting processes, reporting efficiency, and internal controls.
- Support ERP and finance system initiatives, including continuous process improvements.
- Business Partner to the Finance Controller:
- Support monthly, quarterly, and year-end financial close activities.
- Assist in managing credit & collection efforts to mitigate credit risk
- Manage the consolidation of group company month- and year-end financial results.
- Assist in annual physical inventories
- Participate in annual budgeting and forecasting activities.
- Analyze financial results, investigate variances, and support business growth initiatives.
- Provide Key CAR support and other ad hoc financial analysis as requested.

- Treasury Management: - Manage and reconcile cash against In-House Bank accounts
- Support cash from operations forecasting and reporting
- Assist with initiatives focused on maximizing Cash from Operations

- Compliance work: - Support internal and external audit activities.
- Assist in sales and use tax preparation and other regulatory filings.
- Assist tax accountants by gathering requested information in a timely manner.
- Ensure compliance with U.S. GAAP, SOX controls, company accounting policies, and international reporting requirements.
- Promote best practices across finance processes and internal controls.

- Project accounting: - Support project accounting activities, including revenue recognition and proper presentation of Contract Assets and Contract Liabilities.
- Support project bid budgets and executive reviews.
- Partner with project teams to identify financial risks, mitigation plans, and opportunities.
- Support inventory accounting, standard costing, manufacturing variances, work-in-process (WIP) accounting.

- Team Leadership: - Lead, develop, and motivate a small USA finance team, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, continuous improvement, and business partnership.
- Establish departmental and individual goals while providing coaching, mentorship, and professional development opportunities.
- Build organizational capability across financial planning and analysis, commercial finance, treasury, and operational finance functions.
- Mentor and support team members while contributing to a positive, high-performing work environment.

- Other duties as assigned

jobs.title: Lean Leader
jobs.description:
Who will you be working with?
The Friction Product Line designs and manufactures high-friction and low-friction composition, sintered brake shoes, specialty shoes, and disc brake linings for freight, locomotive and transit vehicles.
How will you make a difference?
The Lean Leader is responsible for driving the lean transformation, installing standards to sustain process improvements, and supporting leadership to develop the lean capabilities of all team members in the value stream.
What do we want to know about you?
- Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university preferred.
- 10+ years of experience leading Lean and business operating system transformations within manufacturing environments, with demonstrated success driving organizational change across all levels is preferred.
- Deep knowledge of Toyota Production System (TPS) principles, including servant leadership, customer focus, capability development, standard work, pull systems, and problem-solving methodologies.
- Proven ability to lead through influence, coaching, mentoring, and teaching, using a hands-on approach to develop Lean capabilities and high-performing teams.
- Strong project and program management experience, including planning, execution, stakeholder alignment, and sustainment of improvement initiatives in matrixed organizations.
- Excellent communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
- Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams while motivating, developing, and inspiring others.

What will your typical day look like?
- Lead, coach, and develop the Lean team and plant leadership to strengthen Lean expertise, change management capabilities, problem-solving skills, and continuous improvement execution.
- Develop and execute the site's Lean strategy to improve customer outcomes, including cycle time, on-time delivery, quality, and overall operational performance.
- Serve as a change agent by implementing and sustaining Lean principles, daily management, standard work, and disciplined problem-solving practices throughout plant operations.
- Coach leaders and teams on Lean methodologies and tools, including Hoshin Kanri, Kaizen, A3 problem solving, value stream mapping, Kanban, visual management, flow, pull systems, and standard work.
- Lead the implementation and continuous improvement of the Wabtec Management System (WMS), ensuring compliance with standard processes and fostering a culture of accountability and operational excellence.
- Build organizational capability through rapid improvement cycles that increase engagement, confidence, and the overall pace of change.
- Deliver strategic Lean initiatives and business objectives established by Group Lean Leadership, driving projects to successful completion with minimal oversight.

What about the physical demands of the job?

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. You may also be asked to perform other duties outside of your function or trade, for which adequate training will be provided if necessary.
Examples
- Regularly lift a minimum of fifty pounds (50lbs).
- Working outside in extreme heat and cold weather.
- Frequently stand, walk, bend, crouch, push and pull.
- Regularly exposed to work near moving mechanical parts and extreme heat (non-weather).
- Occasionally exposed to airborne particles.
- Travel will be up to 10%

Wabtec will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the U.S. for this opening. Any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a drug screen (as applicable) and fitness for duty test (as applicable).

jobs.title: Fleet Innovation and Transformation Lead Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
Who will you be working with?
Our Freight Services Division provides locomotive maintenance services to our customers, the country’s largest freight railroads, helping them keep their locomotives running at optimal levels.  The mission of the Fleet Innovation & Transformation team is to accelerate fleet transformation by consistently providing compelling solutions and innovative technologies that improve reliability, sustainability, and performance.

How will you make a difference?
The Lead Systems Engineer leads locomotive modernization and NPI projects and initiatives with broad scope and high impact to the business as a recognized expert in a specialized field. In this role you will be responsible for major and complex assignments with long-term business implications, manage complex issues within functional area(s) of expertise, and contribute to the overall business strategy.  The Lead Systems Engineer’s focus is to interpret and communicate system level customer product requirements to supporting subsystems and validate that they are met through the design review process and validation testing.  In this role you will lead projects from conception to customer delivery by being the primary technical interface between the product teams, engineering design, and manufacturing implementation.

What do we want to know about you?
Qualifications/ Requirements :
- Bachelor of Science in Engineering, Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, or Computer Science
- At least 3 years of system design experience

Desired Characteristics:
- Master’s degree in Engineering
- Strong electrical/mechanical design and analytical background
- Familiarity with manufacturing processes
- Ability to drive projects to completion
- Strong oral and written communication skills
- Strong interpersonal and leadership skills
- Ability to influence all organizations within the business
- Ability to interface effectively with all levels of the organization, and external customers
- North America and International legacy locomotive expertise

What will your typical day look like?
- Ability to excel in a lean mission-based team environment though optimized designs, validation scope, and customer focused results
- Provide technical leadership for a team of engineers for all product design aspects of the assigned NPI and/or locomotive modernization projects
- Deliver strong and concise requirements and product definition to the supporting engineering teams
- Provide analytical evaluation of overall system design with focus on design rigor and practical improvements
- Knowledge of engineering processes and tools used to create system level documentation (eDOT, QSW, eDR/Tollgate, DOORS, PLM, Reliance)
- Organizing, performing, and summarizing results from system level validation plans on products
- Legacy locomotive design and control system optimization required for modernization opportunities
- Support and coordinate with interfacing organizations such as commercial, proposals, manufacturing, sourcing, services, reliability, global engineering, and systems engineering
- Support service programs, fulfillment, and New Product Introduction (NPI)
- Communicate progress to all levels of the organization
- Engineering factory support with focus on build, testing, troubleshooting and validation support
- Mentor and develop less experienced personnel
